raw_segments.text: Dogberry, dost thou not suspect my place? Dost thou not suspect my years?
O, that he were here to write me down an ass! But masters, remember that I am an ass,
though it be not written down, yet forget not that I am an ass.
No, thou villain, thou art full of piety, as shall be proved upon thee by good witness.
I am a wise fellow, and which is more an officer, and which is more a householder,
and which is more as pretty a piece of flesh as any in Messina,
and one that knows the law go to, and a rich fellow enough go to,
and a fellow that hath had losses, and one that hath two gowns, and everything handsome about him.
Bring him away! O, that I had been writ down an ass!
